notes: Later documents contradict the earlier plan's drug: the only anticoagulation plan (Perioperative Medication Plan 162990fe, 02/06/2026) is written for warfarin with an enoxaparin bridge and is itself marked 'Written prior to planned transition off warfarin.' The pre-op H&P (03/05/2026) lists apixaban 5 mg PO BID as current with 'Discontinued: warfarin', and the nursing assessment (03/17/2026) records 'patient states warfarin was stopped last month and replaced with Eliquis by cardiology.' No document gives any peri-procedural instruction for apixaban.

The plan's enoxaparin bridge is part of the single warfarin plan entry (one entry per document); pre-op bridge instruction: 'Bridge with enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC q12h starting 3 days prior, last dose 24 hours pre-op.' Post-op bridge restart is in the postop quote.
In the nursing assessment 49e558c2 apixaban is also written by brand name 'Eliquis' in the warfarin note line; a single apixaban entry is recorded for that document.
The plan's 'INR goal 2-3' and 'goal <1.5' are INR targets, not blood pressure or temperature readings.
The medication list flags 'warfarin 5 mg PO daily' as active=False and 'apixaban 5 mg PO BID' as active=True.
